rules.title: One endpoint, and only one
rules.text: PROTOCOL invariant 4 and 'no second wire protocol': clank speaks `/v1/chat/completions` on the endpoint the caller configured, and reaches nothing else — no version check, no telemetry, no second host. `clank-jev` owns the decision protocol and `clank-web` owns the search providers, which is why this rule does not treat `src/jev.rs` or `src/web.rs` as a second endpoint inside clank.

judgement.question: Is this a network destination other than the configurable base URL — a hardcoded host clank would reach without the caller asking for it?

criteria.true: it is a second destination, or a URL that is not the base URL the caller can override
criteria.false: clank has no hardcoded chat host: the caller sets `--base-url`, `CLANK_BASE_URL`, or `[clank].base_url`. Provider endpoints inside `src/jev.rs` or `src/web.rs` are that binary's protocol and `--base-url` replaces them. A doc comment or a string that is never requested is not a destination
